column1: Buffers your inputs to be executed a specified amount of frames later

column1:
Resolution scale. Multiplies output resolution by this value, on each axis relative to window size.
Lower values may improve performance.
Values above 100% can be used for super-sampling, as an intensive but highly effective form of anti-aliasing.

Default: 100%
column2: 相对于窗口大小，按比例调整两个方向的渲染分辨率。降低可改善性能，超过 100% 可进行超采样抗锯齿，但开销较大。\n默认：100%

column1:
Activates MSAA (multi-sample anti-aliasing) from 2x up to 8x, to smooth the edges of rendered geometry.
Higher sample count will result in smoother edges on models, but may reduce performance.

Recommended: 2x or 4x

column1:

Higher frame rate settings may impact CPU performance.
column2: 通过矩阵插值生成额外画面帧，使显示更流畅。仅影响画面，不改变游戏逻辑或漏洞操作。较高帧率可能增加 CPU 开销。\n\n

column1:
(For DirectX backend only)

When Interpolation FPS (Frame Rate) setting is at least this threshold, add one frame of delay (e.g. 16.6 ms for 60 FPS) in order to avoid jitter.This setting allows the CPU to work on one frame while GPU works on the previous frame.
This setting should be used when your computer is too slow to do CPU + GPU work in time.
column2: 仅适用于 DirectX。插值帧率达到此阈值时，增加一帧延迟以减少抖动，例如 60 帧时增加 16.6 毫秒。这样 CPU 处理当前帧时，GPU 可处理上一帧，适用于两者无法在一帧内完成工作的情况。

column2: 撞树有概率掉落最多三根德库木棒，需要已获得过木棒。

column1: Disables heart drops, but not heart placements, like from a Deku Scrub running off\nThis simulates Hero Mode from other games in the series
column2: 取消随机爱心掉落，但不移除固定爱心，例如逃跑的德库商人留下的爱心。模拟系列其他游戏的英雄模式。

column1: All major bosses move and act twice as fast.
column2: 所有主要 Boss 的移动和行动速度加倍。

column1: All regular enemies and mini-bosses move and act twice as fast.
column2: 所有普通敌人和小 Boss 的移动、行动速度加倍。

column1: Always get the heart piece/purple rupee from the spinning Goron pot
column2: 旋转的鼓隆大罐子必定给出心之碎片或紫色卢比。

column1: Always win the heart piece/purple rupee on the first dig in Dampe's grave digging game, just like in rando\nIn a rando file, this is unconditionally enabled
column2: 丹培挖掘小游戏第一次就挖出心之碎片或紫色卢比，和随机模式相同。随机模式存档中此效果始终开启。

column1: All dogs can be traded in and will count as Richard.
column2: 所有狗都可以作为理查德交回。

column1: Cuccos will stay in place longer after putting them down, by a multiple of the value of the slider.
column2: 按滑块指定的倍率延长鸡被放下后停留在原地的时间。

column1: The time between leever groups spawning.
column2: 两批沙地怪生成之间的间隔。

column1: Disable the low HP beeping sound
column2: 关闭生命值过低时的蜂鸣声。

column1: Hides most of the UI when not needed\nNote: Doesn't activate until after loading a new scene
column2: 不需要时隐藏大部分游戏界面，加载新场景后生效。

column1: Disables the voice audio when Navi calls you
column2: 关闭娜薇呼唤林克时的语音。

column1: Disables warning text when you don't have on the Goron/Zora Tunic in Hot/Underwater conditions.
column2: 在高温或水下未穿对应服装时，不显示警告文字。

column1: Preserves the minimap visibility state when going between areas rather than defaulting it to "on" when going through loading zones.
column2: 跨区域时保留小地图的显示状态，不再默认重新打开。

column1: Displays an icon and plays a sound when Stone of Agony should be activated, for those without rumble
column2: 震动石触发时显示图标并播放声音，适合没有震动功能的控制器。

column1: Allows equipping the tunic and boots to c-buttons
column2: 允许将服装和靴子分配到 C 键。

column1: Allows equipment to be removed by toggling it off on\nthe equipment subscreen.
column2: 在装备子菜单中再次选择装备，可以将其卸下。

column1:
Introduces Options for unequipping Link's sword

None: Only Biggoron's Sword/Giant's Knife can be toggled. Doing so will equip the Master Sword.

Child Toggle: This will allow for completely unequipping any sword as child link.

Both Ages: Any sword can be unequipped as either age. This may lead to swordless glitches as Adult.
column2:
设置卸下剑的规则。
无：仅大鼓隆之剑／巨人之刃可切换，卸下后改持大师之剑。
仅孩童：孩童可完全卸下剑。
两种年龄：任何年龄均可卸下剑，成人可能因此触发无剑漏洞。

column1: Allows the Lon Lon Ranch obstacle course reward to be shared across time periods
column2: 隆隆牧场障碍赛奖励可在两个年代共享。

column1: Injects item counts in pickup messages, like golden skulltula tokens and heart pieces
column2: 拾取提示中显示金骷髅蜘蛛徽章、心之碎片等物品的累计数量。

column1: Allows graves to be pulled when child during the day
column2: 孩童在白天也可拉动墓碑。

column1: Allows dogs to follow you anywhere you go, even if you leave the market
column2: 即使离开城下町，狗也能继续跟随。

column1: Removes the input requirement on textboxes after defeating Ganon, allowing Credits sequence to continue to progress
column2: 击败加侬后的文字不再要求按键，让制作人员名单自动继续。

column1: Allows Ice Arrows to melt red ice.\nMay require a room reload if toggled during gameplay.
column2: 冰箭可融化红冰。游戏中开关此设置后可能需要重新进入房间。

column1: Allows Light Arrows to activate sun switches.\nMay require a room reload if toggled during gameplay.
column2: 光箭可触发太阳开关。游戏中开关此设置后可能需要重新进入房间。

column1: Disable random camera wiggle at low health
column2: 关闭低生命值时镜头的随机晃动。

column1: Renders a health bar for enemies when Z-Targeted
column2: 锁定敌人时显示其血条。

column1: Use a different color when aiming at hookshotable collision
column2: 准星瞄准钩索可抓取的表面时，使用不同颜色。

column1: Toggle between standard assets and alternate assets. Usually mods will indicate if this setting has to be used or not.
column2: 切换标准资源与替换资源，是否需要开启请参考模组说明。

column1: Disables bombs always rotating to face the camera. To be used in conjunction with mods that want to replace bombs with 3D objects.
column2: 炸弹不再始终旋转朝向镜头，适合将炸弹替换为 3D 模型的模组。

column1: Disables grottos rotating with the camera. To be used in conjunction with mods that want to replace grottos with 3D objects.
column2: 洞穴入口不再跟随镜头旋转，适合使用 3D 洞穴入口模型的模组。

column1: Turns Bunny Hood invisible while still maintaining its effects.
column2: 隐藏兔子头套的外观，但保留其效果。

column1: Disables the beating animation of the hearts on the HUD.
column2: 关闭界面中爱心跳动的动画。

column1: Allow you to rotate Link on the Equipment menu with the D-pad\nUse D-pad Up or D-pad Down to reset Link's rotation
column2: 在装备菜单中用方向键旋转林克，上下方向键恢复默认朝向。

column1: Allow you to rotate Link on the Equipment menu with the C-buttons\nUse C-Up or C-Down to reset Link's rotation
column2: 在装备菜单中用 C 键旋转林克，C 上／C 下恢复默认朝向。

column1: Allow you to rotate Link on the Equipment menu with the Right Stick\nYou can zoom in by pointing up and reset Link's rotation by pointing down
column2: 在装备菜单中用右摇杆旋转林克，向上可放大，向下恢复默认朝向。

column1: Randomize the animation played each time you open the menu
column2: 每次打开菜单时随机选择动画。

column1: Randomize the animation played on the menu after a certain time
column2: 经过一定时间后，随机切换菜单中的动画。

column1: Randomize the animation played on the menu after a certain time (Idle animations only)
column2: 经过一定时间后，随机切换菜单中的待机动画。

column1: Turns off the Level of Detail setting, making models use their higher-poly variants at any distance
column2: 关闭细节层级简化，任何距离均使用高面数模型。

column1: Turns off the objects draw distance, making objects being visible from a longer range
column2: 取消物体的绘制距离限制，让远处物体也能显示。

column1: The Kokiri are mystical beings that fade into view when approached\nEnabling this will remove their draw distance
column2: 科克里族原本在靠近时逐渐出现，开启此选项可取消他们的绘制距离限制。

column1: Makes all equipment visible, regardless of Age.
column2: 不论年龄，显示所有装备。

column1: Scales all of the Adult Equipment, as well and moving some a bit, to fit on Child Link Better. May not work properly with some mods.
column2: 缩放并调整成人装备，使其更适合孩童林克。可能与部分模组不兼容。

column1: Sets aspect ratio to 4:3 and lowers resolution to 240p, the N64's native resolution
column2: 将画面比例设为 4:3，分辨率降至 N64 原生的 240p。

column1: Displays a tick in the top center of the screen to help with glitch line-ups in SoH, as traditional UI based line-ups do not work outside of 4:3
column2: 在屏幕顶部中央显示对位标记，便于使用漏洞。传统界面对位法在非 4:3 比例下不适用。

column1: Change most 2D items and projectiles on the overworld to their 3D versions
column2: 将场景中大多数二维物品和投射物替换为三维模型。

column1: Disables Black Bar Letterboxes during cutscenes and Z-targeting\nNote: there may be minor visual glitches that were covered up by the black bars\nPlease disable this setting before reporting a bug
column2: 取消过场和锁定时的上下黑边。可能暴露原本被黑边遮住的轻微画面问题，报告问题前请先关闭此选项。

column1: Changes the rupee in the wallet icon to match the wallet size you currently have
column2: 让钱包旁的卢比图标颜色与当前钱包等级匹配。

column1: Always shows dungeon entrance icons on the minimap
column2: 始终在小地图上显示迷宫入口图标。

column1: Renders Gauntlets when using the Bow and Hookshot like in OOT3D
column2: 使用弓和钩索时显示手套，类似《时之笛 3D》。

column1: When medallions are collected, the medallion imprints around the Master Sword pedestal in the Temple of Time will become colored
column2: 获得徽章后，时之神殿大师之剑台座周围对应的徽章印记会着色。

column1:
Disabled: Paths vanish more the higher the resolution (Z-fighting is based on resolution)
Consistent: Certain paths vanish the same way in all resolutions
No Vanish: Paths do not vanish, Link seems to sink in to some paths
This might affect other decal effects
column2:
禁用：分辨率越高，道路因深度冲突而消失越明显。
一致：所有分辨率下以相同方式消失。
不消失：道路不消失，但林克可能看起来陷入地面。
此设置也可能影响其他贴花效果。

column1: Space between text characters (useful for HD font textures)
column2: 调整字符间距，适用于高清字库纹理。

column1: Shows what items you have collected in the file select screen, like in N64 randomizer
column2: 在存档选择画面显示已收集物品，类似 N64 随机版。

column1: Ammo counts in the pause menu will work correctly regardless of the position of items in the inventory
column2: 无论物品在道具栏的位置如何，暂停菜单都正确显示弹药数量。

column1: Makes the L and R buttons in the pause menu the same color
column2: 让暂停菜单的 L 和 R 按钮使用相同颜色。

column1: Makes L and R switch pages like on the GameCube\nZ opens the Debug Menu instead
column2: 像 GameCube 版一样用 L／R 翻页，Z 键改为打开调试菜单。

column1: Removes the dungeon entrance icon on the top-left corner of the screen when no dungeon is present on the current map
column2: 当前地图没有迷宫时，不再在左上角显示迷宫入口图标。

column1: Re-enables the two-handed idle animation, a seemingly finished animation that was disabled on accident in the original game
column2: 重新启用原版中似乎意外关闭的双手武器待机动画。

column1: Fixes a bug where the Gravedigging Tour Heart Piece disappears if the area reloads
column2: 修正重新载入区域后，挖掘之旅的心之碎片消失的问题。

column1: Prevents the Forest Stage Deku Nut upgrade from becoming unobtainable after receiving the Poacher's Saw
column2: 获得偷猎者锯子后，仍可在森林舞台取得德库果实升级。

column1: Correctly centers the Navi text prompt on the HUD's C-Up button
column2: 将娜薇文字提示正确居中于界面的 C 上按钮。

column1: Make Anubis fireballs do fire damage when reflected back at them with the Mirror Shield
column2: 用镜盾反射阿努比斯的火球时，使其造成火焰伤害。

column1: Make the Megaton Hammer's crouch stab able to destroy rocks without first swinging it normally
column2: 巨人之锤无需先普通挥击，就能通过蹲刺破坏岩石。

column1: Make crouch stabbing always do the same damage as a regular slash
column2: 蹲刺始终造成与普通挥剑相同的伤害。

column1: Extend certain credits scenes so the music lines up properly with the visuals
column2: 延长部分制作人员名单场景，使画面与音乐正确对齐。

column1: Prevent the Gerudo Warrior's clothes changing color when changing Link's tunic or using bombs in front of her
column2: 改变林克服装或在格鲁德战士面前使用炸弹时，她的衣服不再错误变色。

column1: Fixes camera slightly drifting to the left when standing still due to a math error
column2: 修正数学误差导致站立时镜头轻微向左漂移。

column1: Fixes camera getting stuck on collision when standing still, also fixes slight shift back in camera when stop moving
column2: 修正站立时镜头被碰撞卡住，以及停止移动时镜头轻微回退的问题。

column1: Fixes camera swing rate when player falls off a ledge and camera swings around
column2: 修正林克从边缘落下时镜头转动的速度。

column1: Adds 5 higher pitches for the Silver Rupee Jingle for the rooms with more than 5 Silver Rupees. Currently only relevant in Master Quest.
column2: 为超过五枚银卢比的房间增加五个更高音阶的提示乐。目前仅适用于里世界。

column1: Fixes authentic out of bounds texture reads, instead loading textures with the correct size
column2: 修正原版纹理读取越界，改为加载正确尺寸的纹理。

column1: Prevents the Poacher's Saw softlock from mashing through the text, or with Skip Text enabled.
column2: 防止快速按键或跳过文字导致偷猎者锯子流程卡死。

column1: Causes respawning enemies, like stalchildren, to appear on land near bodies of water. Fixes an incorrect calculation that acted like water underneath ground was above it.
column2: 让骷髅小孩等会重新生成的敌人也能在水边陆地出现，修正将地底水面误判为地表水面的计算。

column1: Fixes the bushes to drop items correctly rather than spawning undefined items.
column2: 修正灌木生成未定义物品的问题，使掉落正确。

column1: Prevents immediately falling off climbable surfaces if climbing on the edges.
column2: 在可攀爬表面边缘攀爬时，不再立即脱落。

column1: Fixes Link's eyes being open in the opening cutscene when he is supposed to be sleeping.
column2: 修正开场过场中林克睡觉时仍睁着眼睛的问题。

column1: Fixes Darunia's dancing speed so he dances to the beat of Saria's Song, like in vanilla.
column2: 修正达鲁尼亚的舞速，使其像原版一样与莎莉亚之歌节拍一致。

column1: Fixes the two raised floor switches, the one in Forest Temple Basement and the one at the top of Fire Temple. \nThis will lower them, making activating them easier
column2: 降低森林神殿地下室和炎之神殿顶层两处异常凸起的地板开关，使其更容易踩下。

column1: Fixes one Zora's dialogue giving a hint about bringing Ruto's Letter to King Zora to properly occur before moving King Zora rather than after
column2: 让卓拉关于把露托的信交给卓拉王的提示在卓拉王让路前出现，而非之后。

column1: Hide the game version and build details and display the authentic model and texture on the boot logo start screen
column2: 启动标志画面隐藏版本及构建信息，显示原版模型和纹理。

column1: Restore the original red blood from NTSC 1.0/1.1. Disable for green blood
column2: 恢复 NTSC 1.0／1.1 的红色血液，关闭则使用绿色血液。

column1: Restore a bug from NTSC 1.0 that allows casting the Fishing Rod while using the Hover Boots
column2: 恢复 NTSC 1.0 中穿悬浮靴时可以抛竿的漏洞。

column1: Restores N64 Weird Frames allowing weirdshots to behave the same as N64
column2: 还原 N64 特殊帧行为，使相关钩索漏洞表现与 N64 一致。

column1: Allows bombchus to explode out of bounds\nSimilar to GameCube and Wii VC
column2: 允许炸弹鼠在场景边界外爆炸，类似 GameCube 和 Wii VC 版本。

column1: Restore a bug from NTSC 1.0 that allows putting away an item without an animation and performing Putaway Ocarina Items
column2: 恢复 NTSC 1.0 中无动画收起物品的漏洞，可用于收起陶笛物品等操作。

column1: Restore pre-release behavior where defeating a Gold Skulltula will play a cutscene showing it die.
column2: 恢复早期版本击败金骷髅蜘蛛后播放死亡过场的行为。

column1: Restore a bug from NTSC 1.0 that allows bypassing Bongo Bongo's intro cutscene to quickly kill him
column2: 恢复 NTSC 1.0 中跳过邦戈邦戈开场并快速击杀的漏洞。

column1: Restores the original outcomes when performing Reverse Bottle Adventure.
column2: 还原反向瓶子冒险（RBA）漏洞的原始结果。

column1:
Mirrors the world horizontally

- Always: Always mirror the world
- Random: Randomly decide to mirror the world on each scene change
- Random (Seeded): Scenes are mirrored based on the current randomizer seed/file
- Dungeons: Mirror the world in Dungeons
- Dungeons (Vanilla): Mirror the world in vanilla Dungeons
- Dungeons (MQ): Mirror the world in MQ Dungeons
- Dungeons Random: Randomly decide to mirror the world in Dungeons
- Dungeons Random (Seeded): Dungeons are mirrored based on the current randomizer seed/file
column2:
水平镜像世界。
始终：所有场景镜像。
随机：每次切换场景随机决定。
按种子随机：由当前随机种子或存档决定。
迷宫：仅迷宫镜像。
原版迷宫／里世界迷宫：仅对应类型镜像。
迷宫随机：迷宫每次随机决定。
迷宫按种子随机：由种子或存档决定迷宫是否镜像。

column1:
Replaces fixed enemies throughout the game with a random enemy. Bosses, mini-bosses and a few specific regular enemies are excluded.
Enemies that need more than Deku Nuts + either Deku Sticks or a sword to kill are excluded from spawning in "clear enemy" rooms.

- Random: Enemies are randomized every time you load a room
- Random (Seeded): Enemies are randomized based on the current randomizer seed/file
column2:
将固定敌人替换为随机敌人，主要 Boss、小 Boss 和少数特殊敌人除外。
要求清除敌人的房间，不生成仅靠德库果实配合木棒或剑无法击败的敌人。
随机：每次载入房间重新随机。
按种子随机：由当前随机种子或存档决定。

column1: Enemies and Bosses spawn with random sizes.
column2: 敌人与 Boss 以随机体型出现。

column1: Scales normal enemies health with their randomized size. *This will NOT affect bosses*
column2: 普通敌人的生命值随随机体型变化，不影响 Boss。

column1: Enables Ivan the Fairy upon the next map change. Player 2 can control Ivan and press the C-Buttons to use items and mess with Player 1!
column2: 下次切换地图时启用精灵伊万。玩家二可控制伊万，并按 C 键使用物品干扰玩家一。

column1: Rupees reduced over time, Link suffers damage when the count hits 0.
column2: 卢比随时间减少，降至零后林克会持续受伤。

column1: Interval between Rupee reduction in Rupee Dash Mode
column2: 卢比消耗模式中，每次扣除卢比的时间间隔。

column1: A wallmaster follows Link everywhere, don't get caught!
column2: 墙壁大师会一直追踪林克，小心别被抓住！

column1:
Changes Heart Piece and Heart Container functionality.

- Each Heart Container or full Heart Piece reduces Links hearts by 1.
- Can be enabled retroactively after a File has already started.
column2: 改变心之碎片和心之容器的效果。每个容器或凑齐的一组碎片会减少一颗心的上限，也可用于已有进度的存档。

column1: Automatically save the game when changing locations and/or obtaining items\nMajor items exclude rupees and health/magic/ammo refills (but include bombchus unless bombchu drops are enabled)
column2: 切换地点或获得物品时自动保存。重要物品不包括卢比及生命、魔力、弹药补给；炸弹鼠通常算重要物品，开启炸弹鼠掉落后除外。

column1: Makes every tunic have the effects of every other tunic
column2: 每件服装都拥有其他所有服装的效果。

column1: Passive Infinite Sword Glitch\nIt makes your sword's swing effect and hitbox stay active indefinitely
column2: 自动启用无限剑攻击漏洞，使剑的挥动效果和攻击判定持续存在。

column1: Gives you the glitched damage value of the quick put away glitch.
column2: 获得快速收起攻击漏洞产生的异常伤害值。

column1: Allows any item to be equipped, regardless of age\nAlso allows Child to use Adult strength upgrades
column2: 任何年龄均可装备所有物品，孩童也能使用成人的力量升级。

column1: Allows you to use any item at any location
column2: 允许在任何地点使用任意物品。

column1: Prevents the Deku Shield from burning on contact with fire
column2: 德库盾接触火焰时不会被烧毁。

column1: This allows you to put up your shield with any two-handed weapon in hand except for Deku Sticks
column2: 除德库木棒外，持双手武器时也能举盾。

column1: Makes every surface in the game hookshot-able
column2: 所有表面均可被钩索勾住。

column1: Switches Link's age and reloads the area.
column2: 切换林克的年龄，并重新载入当前区域。

column1: Clears the cutscene pointer to a value safe for wrong warps.
column2: 将过场指针清空为适合错误传送的安全值。

column1: F5 to save, F6 to change slots, F7 to load
column2: F5 保存状态，F6 切换槽位，F7 读取状态。

column1: Allows you to walk through walls
Makes every surface in the game climbable
Holding L makes you float into the air
column2: 按住 L 键即可向空中漂浮。

column1: Continue holding START button when unpausing to only advance a single frame and then re-pause

column1:
Closed - Kokiri sword & shield are required to access the Deku Tree, and completing the Deku Tree is required to access the Hyrule Field exit.

Closed Deku - Kokiri boy no longer blocks the path to Hyrule Field but Mido still requires the Kokiri sword and Deku shield to access the tree.

Open - Mido no longer blocks the path to the Deku Tree. Kokiri boy no longer blocks the path out of the forest.
column2:
关闭：进入德库树需要科奇里之剑和盾，通关德库树后才能前往海拉鲁平原。

仅关闭德库树：科奇里少年不再阻挡通往平原的道路，但米多仍要求剑和德库盾。

开放：米多不再阻挡德库树入口，科奇里少年也不再阻挡离开森林的道路。

column1: Closed - The gate will remain closed until Zelda's letter is shown to the guard.\n\nOpen - The gate is always open. The happy mask shop will open immediately after obtaining Zelda's letter.
column2: 关闭：向守卫出示塞尔达的信后才能开门。\n\n开放：大门始终开启，获得塞尔达的信后面具店立即开业。

column1:
Closed - The Ocarina of Time, the Song of Time and all three spiritual stones are required to open the Door of Time.

Song only - Play the Song of Time in front of the Door of Time to open it.

Open - The Door of Time is permanently open with no requirements.
column2:
关闭：需要时之笛、时之歌和三颗精灵石才能打开时之门。

仅需歌曲：在时之门前演奏时之歌即可开启。

开放：时之门永久开启，无需条件。

column1:
Closed - King Zora obstructs the way to Zora's Fountain. Ruto's letter must be shown as child Link in order to move him in both time periods.

Closed as child - Ruto's Letter is only required to move King Zora as child Link. Zora's Fountain starts open as adult.

Open - King Zora has already mweeped out of the way in both time periods. Ruto's Letter is removed from the item pool.
column2:
关闭：卓拉王挡住通往卓拉泉的道路。少年林克出示露朵的信后，两个时代的道路都会开放。

少年时期关闭：只有少年时期需要出示露朵的信，成年时期默认开放。

开放：两个时代的卓拉王都已让路，露朵的信从物品池中移除。

column1:
Choose which age Link will start as.

Starting as adult means you start with the Master Sword in your inventory.
The child option is forcefully set if it would conflict with other options.
column2:
选择林克的初始年龄。

以成年开始时，物品栏中会拥有大师之剑。
若与其他选项冲突，将强制设为少年。

column1:
Sets the amount of carpenters required to repair the bridge in Gerudo Valley.

Normal - All 4 carpenters are required to be saved.

Fast - Only the bottom left carpenter requires rescuing.

Open - The bridge is repaired from the start.

Only "Normal" is compatible with Gerudo Fortress Key Rings.
column2:
设置修复格鲁德谷桥梁所需营救的木匠数量。

普通：营救全部 4 名木匠。

快速：只需营救左下方的木匠。

开放：桥梁从一开始就已修复。

只有“普通”兼容格鲁德要塞钥匙串。

column1:
Alters the requirements to open the bridge to Ganon's Castle.

Vanilla - Obtain the Shadow Medallion, Spirit Medallion and Light Arrows.

Always open - No requirements.

Stones - Obtain the specified amount of spiritual stones.

Medallions - Obtain the specified amount of medallions.

Dungeon rewards - Obtain the specified total sum of spiritual stones or medallions.

Dungeons - Complete the specified amount of dungeons. Dungeons are considered complete after stepping in to the blue warp after the boss.

Tokens - Obtain the specified amount of Skulltula tokens.

Greg - Find Greg the Green Rupee.
column2:
修改通往加侬城堡的桥梁的开启条件。

原版：获得暗之徽章、魂之徽章和光之箭。

始终开放：无需条件。

精灵石：获得指定数量的精灵石。

徽章：获得指定数量的徽章。

迷宫奖励：精灵石与徽章的总数达到指定数量。

迷宫：通关指定数量的迷宫。击败首领后进入蓝色传送点才算通关。

徽章代币：获得指定数量的黄金骷髅蜘蛛徽章。

格雷格：找到名为格雷格的绿色卢比。

column1:
Standard Rewards - Greg does not change logic, Greg does not help open the bridge, max number of rewards on slider does not change.

Greg as Reward - Greg does change logic (can be part of expected path for opening bridge), Greg helps open bridge, max number of rewards on slider increases by 1 to account for Greg. 

Greg as Wildcard - Greg does not change logic, Greg helps open the bridge, max number of rewards on slider does not change.
column2:
标准奖励：格雷格不影响逻辑、不帮助开桥，奖励数量滑块的上限不变。

格雷格计为奖励：格雷格影响逻辑，可能成为开桥的必经步骤；可帮助开桥，奖励数量上限增加 1。

格雷格作为替代：格雷格不影响逻辑，但可帮助开桥，奖励数量上限不变。

column1:
Sets the number of Ganon's Trials required to dispel the barrier.

Skip - No Trials are required and the barrier is already dispelled.

Set Number - Select a number of trials that will be required from theslider below. Which specific trials you need to complete will be random.

Random Number - A Random number and set of trials will be required.
column2:
设置解除结界所需完成的加侬试炼数量。

跳过：无需试炼，结界已解除。

指定数量：使用下方滑块选择数量，具体试炼随机决定。

随机数量：随机决定试炼数量及其种类。

column1: Set the number of trials required to enter Ganon's Tower.
column2: 设置进入加侬塔所需完成的试炼数量。

column1:
Sets the number of Master Quest Dungeons that are shuffled into the pool.

None - All Dungeons will be their Vanilla versions.

Set Number - Select a number of dungeons that will be their Master Quest versions using the slider below. Which dungeons are set to be the Master Quest variety will be random.

Random Number - A Random number and set of dungeons will be their Master Quest varieties.

Selection - Leave unchecked for Vanilla and checked for Master Quest.
column2:
设置混入的大师模式迷宫数量。

无：所有迷宫均为原版。

指定数量：通过滑块选择数量，具体迷宫随机决定。

随机数量：随机决定数量与迷宫。

自行选择：未勾选使用原版，勾选使用大师模式。

column1:
Pieces of the Triforce of Courage have been scattered across the world. Find them all to finish the game!

When the required amount of pieces have been found, the game is saved and Ganon's Boss key is given to you when you load back into the game if you desire to beat Ganon afterwards.

Keep in mind Ganon might not be logically beatable when "All Locations Reachable" is turned off.
column2:
勇气三角力量碎片散落在世界各处，找到所需数量即可完成游戏！

集齐后会自动保存。若还想挑战加侬，重新加载游戏后会获得加侬首领钥匙。

关闭“所有地点可到达”时，逻辑不保证能够击败加侬。
世界中的三角力量碎片：%d

column1: The amount of Triforce pieces that will be placed in the world. Keep in mind seed generation can fail if more pieces are placed than there are junk items in the item pool.
column2: 放入世界的三角力量碎片数量。若超过物品池中杂项物品的数量，种子生成可能失败。
获胜所需三角力量碎片：%d

column1: The amount of Triforce pieces required to win the game.
column2: 完成游戏所需的三角力量碎片数量。

column1:
Shuffle the pool of dungeon entrances, including Bottom of the Well, Ice Cavern and Gerudo Training Grounds.

Shuffling Ganon's Castle can be enabled separately.

Additionally, the entrances of Deku Tree, Fire Temple, Bottom of the Well and Gerudo Training Ground are opened for both child and adult.

- Deku Tree will be open for adult after Mido has seen child Link with a sword and shield.
- Bottom of the Well will be open for adult after playing Song of Storms to the Windmill guy as child.
- Gerudo Training Ground will be open for child after adult has paid to open the gate once.
column2:
打乱迷宫入口，包括井底、冰之洞窟和格鲁德训练场。

加侬城堡可单独启用。

德库树、火之神殿、井底和格鲁德训练场也会向两个年龄开放。

德库树：少年林克向米多展示剑盾后，成年也可进入。
井底：少年向风车男子演奏风暴之歌后，成年也可进入。
格鲁德训练场：成年付费开门一次后，少年也可进入。

column1:
Shuffle the pool of dungeon boss entrances. This affects the boss rooms of all stone and medallion dungeons.

Age Restricted - Shuffle the entrances of child and adult boss rooms separately.

Full - Shuffle the entrances of all boss rooms together. Child may be expected to defeat Phantom Ganon and/or Bongo Bongo.
column2:
打乱精灵石与徽章迷宫的首领房间入口。

限制年龄：少年与成年首领房间分别打乱。

完全打乱：所有首领房间混合，少年可能需要击败幻影加侬或邦戈邦戈。

column1:
Shuffle the pool of Overworld entrances, which corresponds to almost all loading zones between overworld areas.

Some entrances are unshuffled to avoid issues:
- Hyrule Castle Courtyard and Garden entrance
- Both Market Back Alley entrances
- Gerudo Valley to Lake Hylia (unless entrances are decoupled)
column2:
打乱地面区域间的大部分场景切换入口。

为避免问题，以下入口保持原状：
海拉鲁城堡庭院与花园入口；
城镇后巷的两个入口；
格鲁德谷至海利亚湖（除非启用入口分离）。

column1:
Shuffle the pool of interior entrances which contains most Houses and all Great Fairies.

All - An extended version of 'Simple' with some extra places:
- Windmill
- Link's House
- Temple of Time
- Kakariko Potion Shop
column2:
打乱大部分房屋和所有大妖精泉的入口。

“全部”在“简单”基础上额外包含：
风车、林克的家、时之神殿、卡卡利科药店。

column1: Shuffle the pool of grotto entrances, including all graves, small Fairy fountains and the Deku Theatre.
column2: 打乱地洞入口，包括所有坟墓、小妖精泉和德库剧场。

column1: Randomize where Kaepora Gaebora (the Owl) drops you at when you talk to him at Lake Hylia or at the top of Death Mountain Trail.
column2: 随机决定在海利亚湖或死亡之山顶与猫头鹰对话后，被带到的地点。

column1: Randomize where each of the 6 warp songs leads to.
column2: 随机决定六首传送歌曲各自的目的地。

column1:
Randomize where you start as Child or Adult when loading a save in the Overworld. This means you may not necessarily spawn inside Link's House or Temple of Time.

This stays consistent after saving and loading the game again.

Keep in mind you may need to temporarily disable the "Remember Save Location" time saver to be able use the spawn positions, especially if they are the only logical way to get to certain areas.
column2:
随机决定在地面区域加载存档时，少年或成年林克出现的位置，不一定是林克的家或时之神殿。

保存并重新加载后，出生点保持一致。

可能需要暂时关闭“记住保存位置”，尤其当出生点是逻辑上前往某区域的唯一途径时。

column1: Decouple entrances when shuffling them. This means you are no longer guaranteed to end up back where you came from when you go back through an entrance.\n\nThis also adds the one-way entrance from Gerudo Valley to Lake Hylia in the pool of overworld entrances when they are shuffled.
column2: 打乱入口时将来回方向分离，原路返回不再保证回到来处。\n\n也会将格鲁德谷至海利亚湖的单向入口加入地面入口池。

column1: Shuffle entrances into a mixed pool instead of separate ones. Has no affect on pools whose entrances aren't shuffled, and "Shuffle Boss Entrances" must be set to "Full" to include them.\n\nFor example, enabling the settings to shuffle grotto, dungeon, and overworld entrances and selecting grotto and dungeon entrances here will allow a dungeon to be inside a grotto or vice versa, while overworld entrances are shuffled in their own separate pool and indoors stay vanilla.
column2: 将所选入口类型混在同一个池中打乱。未启用打乱的类型不受影响，首领入口须设为“完全打乱”才能加入。\n\n例如，同时打乱地洞、迷宫和地面入口，并在此混合地洞与迷宫后，迷宫可能位于地洞内，反之亦然；地面入口仍单独打乱，室内保持原版。

column1: Dungeon entrances will be part of the mixed pool
column2: 将迷宫入口加入混合池。

column1: Boss entrances will be part of the mixed pool
column2: 将首领入口加入混合池。

column1: Overworld entrances will be part of the mixed pool
column2: 将地面区域入口加入混合池。

column1: Interior entrances will be part of the mixed pool
column2: 将室内入口加入混合池。

column1: Grotto entrances will be part of the mixed pool
column2: 将地洞入口加入混合池。

column1:
Song locations - Songs will only appear at locations that normally teach songs.

Dungeon rewards - Songs appear after beating a major dungeon boss.
The 4 remaining songs are located at:
  - Zelda's lullaby location
  - Ice Cavern's Serenade of Water location
  - Bottom of the Well Lens of Truth location
  - Gerudo Training Ground's Ice Arrows location

Anywhere - Songs can appear at any location.
column2:
歌曲地点：歌曲只出现在原本传授歌曲的地点。

迷宫奖励：击败主要迷宫首领后获得歌曲。剩余四首位于：
塞尔达摇篮曲地点；
冰之洞窟的水之小夜曲地点；
井底的真实之眼地点；
格鲁德训练场的冰之箭地点。

任意地点：歌曲可出现在任何地点。

column1:
Shuffles Golden Skulltula Tokens into the item pool. This means Golden Skulltulas can contain other items as well.

Off - GS tokens will not be shuffled.

Dungeons - Only shuffle GS tokens that are within dungeons.

Overworld - Only shuffle GS tokens that are outside of dungeons.

All Tokens - Shuffle all 100 GS tokens.
column2:
将黄金骷髅蜘蛛徽章加入随机物品池，黄金骷髅蜘蛛也可能掉落其他物品。

关闭：不打乱徽章。

迷宫：只打乱迷宫内的徽章。

地面：只打乱迷宫外的徽章。

全部：打乱全部 100 枚徽章。
夜间骷髅蜘蛛要求太阳之歌

column1: All Golden Skulltulas that require nighttime to appear will only be expected to be collected after getting Sun's Song.
column2: 逻辑仅在获得太阳之歌后，才要求收集夜间出现的黄金骷髅蜘蛛。

column1: Shuffles the Kokiri Sword into the item pool.\n\nThis will require the use of sticks until the Kokiri Sword is found.
column2: 将科奇里之剑加入物品池。\n\n找到剑之前需要使用德库棒。

column1:
Shuffles the Master Sword into the item pool.

Adult Link will start with a second free item instead of the Master Sword.
If you haven't found the Master Sword before facing Ganon, you won't receive it during the fight.
column2:
将大师之剑加入物品池。

成年林克开局将获得第二件免费物品，代替大师之剑。
若挑战加侬前尚未找到大师之剑，战斗中也不会获得它。

column1: Enabling this shuffles the Fairy Ocarina and the Ocarina of Time into the item pool.\n\nThis will require finding an Ocarina before being able to play songs.
column2: 将妖精之笛与时之笛加入物品池。\n\n找到笛子后才能演奏歌曲。

column1:
Shuffles the Weird Egg from Malon in to the item pool. Enabling "Skip Child Zelda" disables this feature.

The Weird Egg is required to unlock several events:
  - Zelda's Lullaby from Impa
  - Saria's song in Sacred Forest Meadow
  - Epona's song and chicken minigame at Lon Lon Ranch
  - Zelda's letter for Kakariko gate (if set to closed)
  - Happy Mask Shop sidequest
column2:
将玛隆给的奇怪的蛋加入物品池。启用“跳过少年塞尔达”时无法使用。

奇怪的蛋是解锁以下事件的条件：
从英帕处学习塞尔达摇篮曲；
圣域森林的萨莉亚之歌；
隆隆牧场的艾波娜之歌和抓鸡游戏；
用于开启卡卡利科大门的塞尔达的信；
面具店支线任务。

column1: Shuffles the Gerudo Membership Card into the item pool.\n\nThe Gerudo Card is required to enter the Gerudo Training Grounds, opening the gate to Haunted Wasteland and the Horseback Archery minigame.
column2: 将格鲁德会员卡加入物品池。\n\n会员卡是进入格鲁德训练场、开启幽灵沙漠大门和参加骑射游戏的条件。

column1:
Off - All shop items will be the same as vanilla.

0 Items - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops.

1-4 Items - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops, and each shop will contain 1-4 non-vanilla shop items.

Random - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops, and each shop will contain a random number(1-4) of non-vanilla shop items.
column2:
关闭：商店物品保持原版。

0 件：原版商品在不同商店之间打乱。

1—4 件：打乱原版商品，每家商店另有 1—4 件非原版商品。

随机：打乱原版商品，每家商店的非原版商品数量随机为 1—4 件。

column1: Balanced - The default randomization. Shop prices for shopsanity items will range between 0 to 300 rupees, with a bias towards values slightly below the middle of the range, in multiples of 5.\n \nX Wallet - Randomized between 5 and the wallet's max size, in multiples of 5
column2: 均衡：默认随机方式，价格为 0—300 卢比的 5 的倍数，偏向略低于中间值。\n\n指定钱包：价格在 5 卢比到钱包容量之间随机，取 5 的倍数。

column1:
Random selection between the selected wallet tier's affordable price and the affordable prices of the preceding wallet tiers.

Affordable prices per tier: starter = 10, adult = 105, giant = 205, tycoon = 505

Use this to enable wallet tier locking, but make shop items not as expensive as they could be.
column2:
在所选钱包等级及更低等级的可负担价格之间随机选择。

各等级价格：初始 10、成人 105、巨人 205、大富豪 505。

可用于按钱包等级限制购买，同时避免商品过于昂贵。

column1:
Off - Scrubs will not be shuffled. The 3 Scrubs that give one-time items in the vanilla game (PoH, Deku Nut capacity, and Deku Stick capacity) will have random items.

Affordable - Scrubs will be shuffled and their item will cost 10 rupees.

Expensive - Scrubs will be shuffled and their item will cost the vanilla price.

Random - Scrubs will be shuffled and their item will cost will be between 0-95 rupees.
column2:
关闭：不打乱德库商人。原版给予一次性物品的三位商人（心之碎片、德库果容量、德库棒容量）仍给予随机物品。

便宜：打乱商人，售价 10 卢比。

昂贵：打乱商人，使用原版价格。

随机：打乱商人，售价随机为 0—95 卢比。

column1: Cows give a randomized item from the pool upon performing Epona's Song in front of them.
column2: 在牛面前演奏艾波娜之歌后，会获得物品池中的随机物品。

column1: Enabling this adds a pack of 10 beans to the item pool and changes the Magic Bean Salesman to sell a random item at a price of 60 rupees.
column2: 将一包 10 颗魔法豆加入物品池，魔法豆商人改为以 60 卢比出售随机物品。

column1:
Enabling this changes Medigoron, Granny and the Carpet Salesman to sell a random item once at a high price (100 for Granny, 200 for the others).
A Giant's Knife and a pack of Bombchus will be added to the item pool, and one of the bottles will contain a Blue Potion.

On (no hints) - Salesmen will be included but won't tell you what you'll get.
On (with hints) - Salesmen will be included and you'll know what you're buying.

Granny's item will only be offered after you have traded in the Odd Mushroom when Shuffle Adult Trade is on. Otherwise when off, you will need to have found the Claim Check to buy her item (simulating the trade quest is complete).
column2:
让大鼓隆商人、婆婆和飞毯商人各出售一件随机物品，婆婆售价 100 卢比，另外两位为 200。
物品池中增加巨人之刀和一包炸弹鼠，其中一个瓶子装有蓝色药水。

开启（无提示）：商人不告知商品内容。
开启（有提示）：购买前可知道商品内容。

启用成年交易打乱时，须交出奇怪的蘑菇才能购买婆婆的商品；未启用时，须先找到兑换券，视为完成交易任务。

column1:
Shuffles 5 Purple Rupees into to the item pool, and allows
you to earn items by playing songs at the Frog Choir.

This setting does not effect the item earned from playing
the Song of Storms and the frog song minigame.
column2: 将 5 枚紫色卢比加入物品池，并允许通过向青蛙合唱团演奏歌曲获得物品。\n\n不影响风暴之歌和青蛙演奏小游戏的奖励。

column1:
Adds all of the adult trade quest items into the pool, each of which can be traded for a unique reward.

You will be able to choose which of your owned adult trade items is visible in the inventory by selecting the item with A and using the control stick or D-pad.

If disabled, only the Claim Check will be found in the pool.
column2:
将所有成年交易任务物品加入物品池，每件均可交换独特奖励。

在物品栏中用 A 选中交易物品，再用摇杆或方向键切换已拥有的物品。

关闭时，物品池中只有兑换券。

column1: Shuffle the item the cursed rich man in the House of Skulltula gives when you have collected all 100 Gold Skulltula Tokens.\n\nYou can still talk to him multiple times to get Huge Rupees.
column2: 打乱收集全部 100 枚黄金骷髅蜘蛛徽章后，骷髅蜘蛛之家被诅咒富翁给予的奖励。\n\n仍可反复对话获得巨额卢比。

column1:
Shuffles the location of spiritual stones and medallions.

End of dungeons - Spiritual stones and medallions will be given as rewards for beating major dungeons. Link will always start with one stone or medallion.

Any dungeon - Spiritual stones and medallions can be found inside any dungeon.

Overworld - Spiritual stones and medallions can only be found outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Spiritual stones and medallions can appear anywhere.
column2:
打乱精灵石和徽章的位置。

迷宫终点：作为通关主要迷宫的奖励，林克开局总会获得一颗精灵石或一枚徽章。

任意迷宫：可位于任何迷宫内。

地面区域：只能位于迷宫外。

任意地点：可出现在任何地点。

column1:
Start with - You will start with Maps & Compasses from all dungeons.

Vanilla - Maps & Compasses will appear in their vanilla locations.

Own dungeon - Maps & Compasses can only appear in their respective dungeon.

Any dungeon - Maps & Compasses can only appear inside of any dungon.

Overworld - Maps & Compasses can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Maps & Compasses can appear anywhere in the world.
column2:
开局拥有：获得所有迷宫的地图和罗盘。

原版：位于原版位置。

所属迷宫：只能位于各自对应的迷宫。

任意迷宫：可位于任何迷宫内。

地面区域：只能位于迷宫外。

任意地点：可出现在世界任何地方。

column1:
Start with - You will start with all Small Keys from all dungeons.

Vanilla - Small Keys will appear in their vanilla locations. You start with 3 keys in Spirit Temple MQ because the vanilla key layout is not beatable in logic.

Own dungeon - Small Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon. If Fire Temple is not a Master Quest dungeon, the door to the Boss Key chest will be unlocked.

Any dungeon - Small Keys can only appear inside of any dungon.

Overworld - Small Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Small Keys can appear anywhere in the world.
column2:
开局拥有：获得所有迷宫的小钥匙。

原版：位于原版位置。大师模式魂之神殿开局给予 3 把钥匙，因为原版布局在逻辑上无法通关。

所属迷宫：只能位于对应迷宫。非大师模式火之神殿中，通往首领钥匙宝箱的门会解锁。

任意迷宫：可位于任何迷宫内。

地面区域：只能位于迷宫外。

任意地点：可出现在世界任何地方。

column1:
Keyrings will replace all small keys from a particular dungeon with a single keyring that awards all keys for it's associated dungeon

Off - No dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Random - A random amount of dungeons(0-8 or 9) will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Count - A specified amount of randomly selected dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Selection - Hand select which dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Selecting key ring for dungeons will have no effect if Small Keys are set to Start With or Vanilla.

If Gerudo Fortress Carpenters is set to Normal, and Gerudo Fortress Keys is set to anything other than Vanilla, then the maximum amount of Key Rings that can be selected by Random or Count will be 9. Otherwise, the maximum amount of Key Rings will be 8.
column2:
钥匙串将某个迷宫的全部小钥匙替换为一件物品，获得时给予该迷宫的所有钥匙。

关闭：不替换。

随机：随机选择 0—8 或 9 个迷宫。

指定数量：随机选择指定数量的迷宫。

自行选择：手动选择迷宫。

小钥匙设为“开局拥有”或“原版”时，此设置无效。

格鲁德要塞木匠设为“普通”且要塞钥匙不设为“原版”时，随机或指定数量的上限为 9，否则为 8。

column1:
Vanilla - Thieve's Hideout Keys will appear in their vanilla locations.

Any dungeon - Thieve's Hideout Keys can only appear inside of any dungon.

Overworld - Thieve's Hideout Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Thieve's Hideout Keys can appear anywhere in the world.
column2:
原版：盗贼藏身处钥匙位于原版位置。

任意迷宫：只能位于迷宫内。

地面区域：只能位于迷宫外。

任意地点：可出现在世界任何地方。

column1:
Start with - You will start with Boss keys from all dungeons.

Vanilla - Boss Keys will appear in their vanilla locations.

Own dungeon - Boss Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon.

Any dungeon - Boss Keys can only appear inside of any dungon.

Overworld - Boss Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Boss Keys can appear anywhere in the world.
column2:
开局拥有：获得所有迷宫的首领钥匙。

原版：位于原版位置。

所属迷宫：只能位于对应迷宫。

任意迷宫：可位于任何迷宫内。

地面区域：只能位于迷宫外。

任意地点：可出现在世界任何地方。

column1:
Vanilla - Ganon's Boss Key will appear in the vanilla location.

Own dungeon - Ganon's Boss Key can appear anywhere inside Ganon's Castle.

Start with - Places Ganon's Boss Key in your starting inventory.
Any dungeon - Ganon's Boss Key Key can only appear inside of any dungon.

Overworld - Ganon's Boss Key Key can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Ganon's Boss Key Key can appear anywhere in the world.

LACS - These settings put the boss key on the Light Arrow Cutscene location, from Zelda in Temple of Time as adult, with differing requirements:
- Vanilla: Obtain the Shadow Medallion and Spirit Medallion
- Stones: Obtain the specified amount of spiritual stones.
- Medallions: Obtain the specified amount of medallions.
- Dungeon rewards: Obtain the specified total sum of spiritual stones or medallions.
- Dungeons: Complete the specified amount of dungeons. Dungeons are considered complete after stepping in to the blue warp after the boss.
- Tokens: Obtain the specified amount of Skulltula tokens.

100 GS Reward - Ganon's Boss Key will be awarded by the cursed rich man after you collect 100 Gold Skulltula Tokens.
column2:
原版：加侬首领钥匙位于原版位置。

所属迷宫：可位于加侬城堡内任何地方。

开局拥有：开局获得。

任意迷宫：只能位于迷宫内。

地面区域：只能位于迷宫外。

任意地点：可出现在世界任何地方。

光之箭过场：成年时期在时之神殿由塞尔达给予，条件可选：
原版：获得暗之徽章和魂之徽章；
精灵石、徽章或迷宫奖励：获得指定数量；
迷宫：通关指定数量，须进入首领后的蓝色传送点；
代币：获得指定数量的黄金骷髅蜘蛛徽章。

100 枚徽章奖励：收集 100 枚黄金骷髅蜘蛛徽章后由被诅咒的富翁给予。

column1:
Standard Rewards - Greg does not change logic, Greg does not help obtain GBK, max number of rewards on slider does not change.

Greg as Reward - Greg does change logic (can be part of expected path for obtaining GBK), Greg helps obtain GBK, max number of rewards on slider increases by 1 to account for Greg. 

Greg as Wildcard - Greg does not change logic, Greg helps obtain GBK, max number of rewards on slider does not change.
column2:
标准奖励：格雷格不影响逻辑、不帮助获得加侬首领钥匙，奖励数量上限不变。

格雷格计为奖励：影响逻辑，可成为获得钥匙的必经步骤；帮助获得钥匙，奖励数量上限增加 1。

格雷格作为替代：不影响逻辑，但帮助获得钥匙，奖励数量上限不变。

column1: The amount of cuccos needed to claim the reward from Anju the cucco lady
column2: 从养鸡姑娘安珠处领取奖励所需找回的咕咕鸡数量。

column1: The Poe collector will give a reward for turning in this many Big Poes.
column2: 向幽灵收集者交出此数量的大幽灵后获得奖励。

column1: The crawlspace into Hyrule Castle goes straight to Zelda, skipping the guards.
column2: 海拉鲁城堡的爬行通道直接通向塞尔达，跳过守卫潜行。

column1: Start with Zelda's Letter and the item Impa would normally give you and skip the sequence up until after meeting Zelda. Disables the ability to shuffle Weird Egg.
column2: 开局拥有塞尔达的信和英帕原本给予的物品，并跳过与塞尔达会面前的流程。无法同时打乱奇怪的蛋。

column1: Epona can be summoned with Epona's Song without needing to race Ingo.
column2: 无需与英戈赛马，即可用艾波娜之歌召唤艾波娜。

column1: The tower escape sequence between Ganondorf and Ganon will be skipped.
column2: 跳过加侬多夫与加侬战之间的城堡逃脱流程。

column1: Once the happy mask shop is opened, all masks will be available to be borrowed.
column2: 面具店开业后即可借用所有面具。

column1: Start with the ability to summon Pierre the scarecrow. Pulling out an ocarina in the usual locations will automatically summon him.
column2: 开局即可召唤稻草人皮埃尔。在通常的召唤地点拿出笛子即可自动召唤。

column1:
Sets how many major items appear in the item pool.

Plentiful - Extra major items are added to the pool.

Balanced - Original item pool.

Scarce - Some excess items are removed, including health upgrades.

Minimal - Most excess items are removed.
column2:
设置物品池中主要物品的数量。

充裕：加入额外主要物品。

均衡：原始物品池。

稀少：移除部分多余物品，包括生命升级。

极少：移除大部分多余物品。

column1:
Sets how many items are replaced by ice traps.

Off - No ice traps.

Normal - Only Ice Traps from the base item pool are shuffled in.

Extra - Chance to replace added junk items with additional ice traps.

Mayhem - All added junk items will be Ice Traps.

Onslaught - All junk items will be replaced by Ice Traps, even those in the base pool.
column2:
设置被冰冻陷阱替换的物品数量。

关闭：没有冰冻陷阱。

普通：仅使用基础物品池中的冰冻陷阱。

额外：新增杂项物品有概率变为冰冻陷阱。

混乱：所有新增杂项物品均为冰冻陷阱。

全面冰冻：包括基础池在内的全部杂项物品均被替换。

column1:
Allows Gossip Stones to provide hints on item locations. Hints mentioning "Way of the Hero" indicate a location that holds an item required to beat the seed.

No hints - No hints will be given at all.

Need Nothing - Hints are always available from Gossip Stones.

Need Stone of Agony - Hints are only available after obtaining the Stone of Agony.

Need Mask of Truth - Hints are only available whilst wearing the Mask of Truth.
column2:
让闲话石提示物品位置。“英雄之路”表示该地点有完成种子所必需的物品。

无提示：不提供提示。

无要求：随时可从闲话石获得提示。

需要苦闷石：获得苦闷石后才可查看。

需要真实面具：佩戴真实面具时才可查看。

column1:
Sets the difficulty of hints.

Obscure - Hints are unique for each item, but the writing may be cryptic.
Ex: Kokiri Sword > a butter knife

Ambiguous - Hints are clearly written, but may refer to more than one item.
Ex: Kokiri Sword > a sword

Clear - Hints are clearly written and are unique for each item.
Ex: Kokiri Sword > the Kokiri Sword
column2:
设置提示的难度。

隐晦：每件物品有独特提示，但表述含蓄，例如科奇里之剑称为“黄油刀”。

模糊：表述清楚，但可能指多件物品，例如称为“一把剑”。

明确：清楚且唯一，例如直接称为“科奇里之剑”。

column1:
Sets how many hints will be useful.

Useless - Only junk hints.

Balanced - Recommended hint spread.

Strong - More useful hints.

Very Strong - Many powerful hints.
column2:
设置有用提示的数量。

无用：仅提供杂项提示。

均衡：推荐分布。

较强：更多有用提示。

很强：大量关键提示。

column1: This setting adds some hints at locations other than Gossip Stones.\n\nHouse of Skulltula: # - Talking to a cursed House of Skulltula resident will tell you the reward they will give you for obtaining that many tokens.
column2: 在闲话石以外的地点增加提示。\n\n骷髅蜘蛛之家：与被诅咒的住户对话，可得知收集对应数量徽章后的奖励。

column1: Reading the Temple of Time altar as child will tell you the locations of the Spiritual Stones.\nReading the Temple of Time altar as adult will tell you the locations of the Medallions, as well as the conditions for building the Rainbow Bridge and getting the Boss Key for Ganon's Castle.
column2: 少年阅读时之神殿祭坛可得知精灵石位置。\n成年阅读可得知徽章位置，以及彩虹桥和加侬城堡首领钥匙的获取条件。

column1: Talking to Ganondorf in his boss room or Sheik inside Ganon's Castle (when trials are enabled) will tell you the location of the Light Arrows.If this option is enabled and Ganondorf is reachable without Light Arrows, Gossip Stones will never hint the Light Arrows.
column2: 与首领房间的加侬多夫或加侬城堡内的希克（启用试炼时）对话，可得知光之箭位置。若无需光之箭即可到达加侬多夫，启用后闲话石不会再提示光之箭。

column1: Reading the diary of Dampé the gravekeeper as adult will tell you the location of one of the Hookshots.
column2: 成年阅读守墓人丹培的日记，可得知一个钩索的位置。

column1: Talking to the chest game owner after buying a key will tell you the location of Greg the Green Rupee.
column2: 购买钥匙后与宝箱游戏老板对话，可得知绿色卢比格雷格的位置。

column1: Talking to Saria either in person or through Saria's Song will tell you the location of a progressive magic meter.
column2: 直接与萨莉亚对话或使用萨莉亚之歌，可得知一次魔力槽升级的位置。

column1: Standing near the pedestal for the frogs in Zora's River will tell you the reward for the frogs' ocarina game.
column2: 靠近卓拉河青蛙的平台时，可得知青蛙笛子游戏的奖励。

column1: Playing a warp song will tell you where it leads. (If warp song destinations are vanilla, this is always enabled.)
column2: 演奏传送歌曲时提示目的地。目的地为原版时，此项始终启用。

column1: Business scrubs will reveal the identity of what they're selling.
column2: 德库商人会告知所售物品的真实内容。

column1: Start with a full wallet. All wallet upgrades come filled with rupees.
column2: 开局钱包装满卢比，所有钱包升级也会装满。

column1:
Bombchus are properly considered in logic.

The first Bombchu pack will always be 20, and subsequent packs will be 5 or 10 based on how many you have.
Once found, they can be replenished at the Bombchu shop.

Bombchu Bowling is opened by obtaining Bombchus.
column2:
将炸弹鼠纳入逻辑判断。

第一包始终为 20 个，后续根据持有量为 5 或 10 个。找到后可在炸弹鼠商店补充。

获得炸弹鼠后开放炸弹鼠保龄球。

column1: Once you obtain bombchus for the first time, refills can be found in bushes and other places where bomb drops can normally spawn.
column2: 首次获得炸弹鼠后，草丛等通常掉落炸弹的地点也可能掉落炸弹鼠补充。

column1: Ice Arrows act like Blue Fire, making them able to melt red ice. Item placement logic will respect this option, so it might be required to use this to progress.
column2: 冰之箭具有蓝色火焰效果，可融化红冰。物品放置逻辑会考虑此设置，推进流程可能需要使用。

column1: Light Arrows can be used to light up the sun switches instead of using the Mirror Shield. Item placement logic will respect this option, so it might be required to use this to progress.
column2: 光之箭可代替镜盾激活太阳开关。物品放置逻辑会考虑此设置，推进流程可能需要使用。

column1:
Glitchless - No glitches are required, but may require some minor tricks. Additional tricks may be enabled and disabled below.

No logic - Item placement is completely random. MAY BE IMPOSSIBLE TO BEAT.

Vanilla - Places all items and dungeon rewards in their vanilla locations.
column2:
无漏洞：不要求利用漏洞，但可能需要简单技巧，可在下方调整额外技巧。

无逻辑：物品完全随机放置，可能无法通关。

原版：所有物品与迷宫奖励位于原版位置。

column1: When this options is enabled, the randomizer will guarantee that every item is obtainable and every location is reachable. When disabled, only required items and locations to beat the game will be guaranteed reachable.
column2: 启用时保证所有物品可获取、所有地点可到达。关闭时只保证通关所需的物品与地点可到达。

column1: The cutscenes of the Poes in Forest Temple and Darunia in Fire Temple will not be skipped. These cutscenes are only useful for glitched gameplay and can be safely skipped otherwise.
